task: Configure a hardened ISP on the xc2ve3558-sfva1440-2MP-e-S with all three tiles enabled and multi-pass disabled. Each tile needs four independent RAW12 inputs to its first ISP and one input to its second ISP—RAW12 on tile 1, 16-bit on tiles 0 and 2. All inputs use four pixels per clock. Expose the corresponding streaming ports, leave other settings at defaults, verify the configuration and ports, and save the design.
scope: One completed attempt per model/condition. Observed configuration and interface checks, not hardware validation. Sol grading adapters were corrected post-run; Luna used the frozen corrected contract.
